name: io.github.ux-llc/uxsearch
title: UX Search: Government Auction Prices
description: Real U.S. government auction winning bids, deal scores and live government auctions.

tools.name: get_sold_prices
tools.description: What an item actually sold for at U.S. government auctions: real winning bids (not dealer or eBay prices) with the median, the middle range, the low and high, prices by model year and the most recent individual sales with links. Use for questions like 'what does a used police Tahoe sell for at auction?'

query.description: Item to price, e.g. "2019 chevrolet tahoe police" or "ford f-250"

state.description: Optional U.S. state name or 2-letter code

days.description: Look back this many days (7 to 1095, default 365)

sort.description: Order of the individual sales listed (default newest)

limit.description: How many individual sales to list (1 to 100, default 15)

tools.name: check_deal
tools.description: Compares a price against real U.S. government auction winning bids for the same item and returns a 0-100 deal score, how it compares with the median, the share of sales it beats and the closest past sales.

query.description: Item, e.g. "2017 ford explorer police interceptor"

tools.name: search_live_auctions
tools.description: Searches live listings on official government auction sites (GSA Auctions, GSA Fleet, U.S. Treasury, IRS, state surplus sites and more) and returns current bids, closing times, locations and links.

tools.name: get_upcoming_sales
tools.description: Upcoming scheduled U.S. government vehicle sales (GSA Fleet live and online events), with dates, places, number of vehicles and links.

tools.name: search_buying_guides
tools.description: Finds UX Auctions guides and articles on buying at government auctions (how to bid, inspect, pay, title, pick up) and stories on what sold.

query.description: Topic, e.g. "how to buy a police car at auction"

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Lists the government and public auction sites UX Search covers.
